responsibility: Implements the main GIMPLE/SSA diagnostics pass for invalid memory and pointer accesses. It uses pointer_query and ranger information to check object sizes, bounds, nonstring and unterminated-array arguments, dangerous allocation/deallocation mismatches, dangling-pointer uses and stores, and related access patterns, issuing the corresponding warnings and notes while traversing basic blocks and maintaining clobber/use context for later dangling checks.
same_name_distinction: The implementation of the full warning pass for invalid accesses and dangling-pointer diagnostics; unlike gcc/gimple-ssa-warn-access.h, which just exposes reusable helper declarations, this file defines pass_waccess and drives CFG/SSA traversal and diagnostic emission.
